scope: NOAA NSDE CUSP index and exact CUSP package manifestations intersecting the bounded Puerto Rico discovery bbox

index.transport: NSDE PBF responses are gzip-compressed; raw bytes are frozen and decompressed only for decoding

downloads.archive_shape: each package contains one readme plus one SHP/SHX/DBF/PRJ polyline family

interpretation.source: CUSP is independent from project-based National Shoreline and is a current NOAA shoreline product; the two 5-degree cells are source package manifestations, not insular identities.
interpretation.geometry: CUSP linework may be used as current shoreline evidence; polygonization remains derived candidate geometry.
interpretation.identity: no CUSP package, line, polygon, or proximity relationship independently establishes canonical insular identity.
